- AGENT.md (created in project root) documents actionable skills for local maintainers and Copilot agents. It includes a 'run-project' skill that starts the supervisor/daemon, streams logs, and explains how to stop them.

Quick run/stop summary (see AGENT.md for details):

- Start supervisor + daemon (background): sh scripts/run.sh start
- Start in foreground and stream logs: sh scripts/run.sh --monitor start   (or sh scripts/run.sh start --monitor)
- Stop supervisor and daemon: sh scripts/run.sh stop
- Check status: sh scripts/run.sh status
- When running in --monitor mode: press Ctrl-C to trigger a graceful shutdown (cleanup_and_exit -> stop_all)
- PID files: run/v-daemon.pid (daemon), run/v-daemon-supervisor.pid (supervisor), run/v-director.pid (director)
- Logs: ./logs/daemon.log, ./logs/supervisor.log, ./logs/director.log
